text:
Elliot (AM): Quick heads up  Orion Labs wants to renew but asks to split the invoice: 70% via PO from main entity, 30% via credit card from a contractor org. They want access next Wed.
Rhea (CS): contractor card + PO combo. any prior approvals for that contractor?
Elliot (AM): nope, new arrangement. Contract signatory still Orion HQ.
Marco (RevOps): recommend two tracks: Fast-card track (card + signed payer auth + 48h manual review) or Standard-PO track (PO only, net14, provisioning after PO). Offer 3-day provisioning buffer if PO delays.
Tasha (Legal): need an amendment specifying split allocation and alternate payer authorization. also include chargeback indemnity for contractor payers. can draft brief clause.
Simon (Finance): we can accept contractor card if we get: signed payer auth, contractor company letter confirming payment role, and matching billing contact. otherwise must be PO. contractor card will go to manual review queue.
billing-bot: Invoice previews: invoice_2026-1177 (70% - $63,000) & invoice_2026-1178 (30% - $27,000) - https://billing.redwood/invoice/preview/2026-1177 & /2026-1178
Rhea (CS): sent amendment + payer auth to procurement@orionlabs. they say contractor can sign today.
Elliot (AM): @Tasha please paste draft so we can send to them. need sign-off by EOD.
Tasha (Legal): Draft: "Amendment: Orion Labs allocates renewal charges: 70% to Orion Labs (PO), 30% to ContractorCo (card). ContractorCo authorizes payment and accepts liability for chargebacks. Orion Labs remains contractually responsible for full amount."
Marco (RevOps): add: "Card payments subject to 48-hour manual verification and provisional hold until cleared."
Tasha (Legal): added. final attached.
Simon (Finance): once signed, create temp payment method and run $1 auth hold. will confirm within 4 hours.
Rhea (CS): contractor returned signed auth and contractor letter. sending to billing.
billing-bot: Temporary payment method created: tmp_card_orion_contractor by Marco. Manual hold applied.
Simon (Finance): verification passed. captured $27,000. EU PO (70%) scheduled after PO receipt.
Elliot (AM): great. provisioning plan set: enable contractor seats now, rest upon PO. reducing renewal risk -> low for contractor portion.
Rhea (CS): updated Gainsight and onboarding plan. saved amendment to contract repo.
Tasha (Legal): saved signed amendment; cc legal.
Elliot (AM): thanks team. closing thread.
